description.value: The largest living history museum in western North America, Barkerville preserves more than 125 heritage buildings along the original Gold Rush streetscape on Williams Creek in the Cariboo. Designated a National Historic Site in 1924, visitors explore working displays, costumed interpreters, and 19th-century shops set amid mountain forests. Cyclists can ride surrounding roads and trails but must push bikes through the Heritage Zone at walking pace.

address.value: Box 19 14301 Highway 26 East, Barkerville, BC V0K 1B0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Barkerville is an active National Historic Site with 125+ heritage buildings, open for the 2026 season (shoulder season currently, main season May 30–Sep 13). The visitor information page has a specific bicycle policy: cycling is permitted on surrounding roads and trails but not within the townsite, and bikes must be pushed at walking pace in the Heritage Zone. Washrooms and Wi-Fi are confirmed as provided services ('sparkling clean bathrooms and Wi-Fi'). Restaurants are mentioned on the main season page. No evidence of bike racks, water refill, showers, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: Cycling not permitted within the Heritage Zone townsite; bikes must be pushed at walking pace. No bike parking or racks mentioned on website.
OSM record had no phone or address; values populated from website contact page.
Restaurants and shops are seasonal (main season only, May 30–Sep 13 2026); off-season visitors may find food unavailable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Major National Historic Site and top Cariboo attraction with explicit bicycle policies, on-site restaurants, washrooms, and Wi-Fi. A natural stop for touring cyclists on Highway 26.
enrichment_extras.notes: Campgrounds and accommodations also available on site (bookable separately). Cyclists must check in at Welcome Centre during main season. 75% wheelchair accessible.

Café or food on site.detail: Main season page references 'Shops, restaurants, and programs' operating on site
